title: Iṣbāḥ al-Anwār ('Lights' Dawning')
transliterated_title: Iṣbāḥ al-Anwār (var. Sharḥ Ḥadīth al-Īmān (?); K. al-Iṣbāḥ)

date.basis: The only date is MK's '841/1438 (?)' for the partial Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 404b-16b), a copying date and itself queried. Composition undated: it was cited as incomplete in the R. Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī (1 Jumādā I 831/17 Feb 1428), so it existed in part by then; MK conjectures it was left unfinished after the events of 1427.

occasion: Conceived, MK conjectures ('perhaps'), as a fuller treatment of lettrism than the Mafāḥiṣ; left unfinished.
manuscript: 1 copy: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 404b-16b (partial, 841/1438 (?)), breaking off mid-page.
summary: A lettrist treatment of the hadith on iḥsān-īmān-islām, cited as incomplete by the Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī and other works; presumably never finished.
